questions.title: The future looks grim
questions.prompt: Inspired by the fortune-telling scene in Prisoner of Azkaban, what real-life service did Charlie think should exist?
options: Reading someone's future from their DoorDash history
Reading someone's future from poop in a toilet
Reading someone's future from a bong's residue
Reading someone's future from their Clash deck
questions.explanation: Charlie wanted divination relocated to the bathroom: poop instead of the grounds, toilet instead of the cup. A new branch of the dark arts.

receipts.text: In prisoner of Azkaban where the lady reads your future with the coffee grounds and cup, they should have that in real life but it’s poop and a toilet

questions.title: Even Jacky has a limit
questions.prompt: Nico remembered one exceptional occasion when Jacky shut his door during the daytime. What lore finally exhausted Jacky's open-door policy?
options: A complete breakdown of a fantasy football draft
An explanation of every change to a Honda engine
questions.explanation: The server-fan lore finally closed the door. Jacky's defense: “I’m happy for him but it was too much”. He normally left the door open to invite distraction.

receipts.text: Bruh I remember there was only one time jacky ever shut his door during the daytime and it was cuz Luke would not shut the fuck up about the new fans he installed onto his server💀💀💀
I’m happy for him but it was too much
I always had the door open partially to invite distraction 💀

questions.title: A semester well spent
questions.prompt: Jimmy watched a marketing group's final pitch get gently dismantled by the professor, who said their entire product idea had been banned for years. What were they pitching?
options: A vape that also works as an inhaler
questions.explanation: Red Bull mixed with Tito's. According to Jimmy, the professor was trying very hard to be nice while explaining why the semester's big idea couldn't work.

receipts.text: This marketing group did a presentation about a new product idea for Red Bull mixed with Tito’s and it was their final project for the semester and the professor was trying so hard to be nice when explaining that their entire idea was illegal and has been banned for years

questions.title: The balance was off
questions.prompt: Nathan remembered an art-museum trip where a painting was basically a blue smudge and a red smudge. What was Dimitri's critique?
options: They had hung it upside down
questions.explanation: “Yeah but there’s too much red😤”. Nathan said it blew his mind. Even the dumb art was cool.

receipts.text: Dude I remember when we went to the art museum we were looking at some stupid ass modern art piece of a blue smudge on one side and a red smudge on the other side, and Dimitri’s was like “yeah but there’s too much red😤” and it blew my mind
Even the dumb art was cool

questions.title: The bowl survived
questions.prompt: Jimmy's friend ordered a loaded Chipotle bowl through DoorDash. After the restaurant ran out of ingredients, what two things actually arrived in the bowl?
questions.explanation: A bowl of sour cream and white rice. The container was doing more work than the kitchen.

receipts.text: My boy just told me that he doordashed chipotle and ordered a bowl with a bunch of stuff in it and they were out of so much that all he got was a bowl of sour cream and white rice
